# PLVS Code of Conduct

We want everyone to be able to participate in PLVS without harassment or discrimination. Treat people with respect, give constructive feedback, and focus criticism on the work. Welcome contributors with different backgrounds and levels of experience.

Harassment, threats, personal attacks, discriminatory language, unwanted sexual attention, and sharing someone's private information without their permission are unacceptable. These standards apply in PLVS community spaces and when someone officially represents the project.

## Reporting and Enforcement

Email [xichen@soundoer.com](mailto:xichen@soundoer.com) to report a concern privately. If you can, describe what happened, when and where it happened, and include any relevant links. The maintainer will handle reports discreetly and limit sharing to what is necessary to address the incident.

Depending on the severity and circumstances, the maintainer may remove content, issue a warning, or restrict participation temporarily or permanently. Retaliation against someone for making or helping with a report is also unacceptable.

This policy draws on the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
